data.body: Consideration: [Conflicting assumptions] S1 must publish a canonical sourced bash helper for array-membership (e.g., stack_has 'language:python') before S5 begins. Bash array membership has multiple correct-looking idioms with subtly different behavior under empty arrays, values with spaces, and set -u. Without a published helper, each consumer in S5 will adopt a different idiom and the S2 audit script cannot regex-check for compliance. S1 owns the helper; S5 mechanically substitutes it.
